newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal disco fire kills 12 people, eight injured.
newsitem.headline: Portugal disco fire kills 12 people, eight injured.

text.p: Twelve people were killed and at least eight injured in a fire at a discotheque in the northern Portuguese town of Amarante on Wednesday, a police spokesman said.
The spokesman said the fire broke out at around 0300 GMT at the discotheque in the town, some 60 km (40 miles) west of the city of Oporto. All the injured were taken to local hospitals.
Police could give no immediate information on the cause of the fire.
But according to witnesses cited by Portuguese radio station TSF, the fire was started deliberately by two individuals who sprayed petrol around the floor.
They said that one of the injured people had been shot when he tried to stop the arson attack.
